serviceDescription: Image upload and CDN management. Upload images, list/delete resources, get secure URLs for Instagram and other integrations.

endpoints.name: upload_image
endpoints.description: Upload an image to Cloudinary using Basic Auth (API Key + Secret). Returns secure_url — the public HTTPS URL to use with Instagram.
endpoints.payload:
resolve_to_base64_$file: local file path to upload (e.g. /home/user/photo.jpg). Required.
public_id: string - Optional identifier for the asset (used in delivery URLs).
folder: string - Optional folder path to organise assets (e.g. "instagram/posts").
tags: string - Optional comma-separated tags.

endpoints.name: get_resource
endpoints.description: Get details of an uploaded image by its public ID, including its secure_url.
endpoints.url_parameters: public_id: string - The public ID of the image.

endpoints.name: list_resources
endpoints.description: List uploaded images in the Cloudinary account.
endpoints.query_params:
max_results: integer - Maximum number of resources to return (default: 10, max: 500).
next_cursor: string - Pagination cursor from a previous response.

endpoints.name: delete_resource
endpoints.description: Delete an uploaded image by its public ID.
endpoints.payload:
public_id: string - The public ID of the image to delete. Required.
invalidate: boolean - Whether to invalidate the CDN cache (default: false).
